name: Political instability
value: No G20 collapse; Indonesia probe continues
summary: Indonesia's wiretapping probe of police generals continues; no G20 government collapse, coup or contested election
state: Indonesia arrested three people including a police general and former police chief over alleged tapping of President Prabowo's phone on 3–4 Nov and deployed extra troops to Jakarta, while ministers said there was no indication of treason (Malay Mail). Searches on 10 Nov found no G20 government collapse, coup or contested election in the past month, so the status stays at Normal.
for_you: No action is needed for most readers. Travellers to Indonesia should check FCDO travel advice for any local security updates.

why: Coups, contested elections and constitutional crises in large economies unsettle markets, alliances and policy.
